newsitem.title: USA: Pan Am Q4 net loss, oper revs of $10.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: Pan Am Q4 net loss, oper revs of $10.2 mln.

text.p: Pan American World Airways on Monday said its fourth quarter operating revenues were $10.2 million and reported expenses of $24.9 million, resulting in a net loss of $14.7 million from start-up operations.
Pan Am said net loss was $27.5 million for the full year 1996, including about nine months of pre-flight activities.
The company did not provide year-ago comparisons, saying it began scheduled service on September 26 and such comparisons were therefore not applicable.
The airline said its loss was consistent with expectations for the pre-start-up and launch periods and that passenger load factors have been rising since it started service.
It said its October load factor was 28.2 percent, its November load factor was 36.9 percent and in December, the load factor was 64.6 percent.

"The very positive increase in load factor has continued in the first two months of 1997," the company said in a release, adding its January load factor was 64.8 percent and that its February load factors was 67.4 percent. It said it expects to report a March load factor of about 69 percent.
